invariants.rationale: The context parameter is likely required to be non-null for any method in this API.
It is generally expected that Option parameters are not null; rather, they are used to encapsulate absence/presence.
If extraMetadata is present, the contained Map should not be null.
If the Option is present, calling orElse(null) should yield a non-null value, and vice versa.
If both parameters are required, they should both be non-null before method execution.
